 This application coming on for admission thi
 following:
 Order
The Advocates are abstaining from Court work today.

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing of order dated 2.9.2021 passed by JMFC, Harsood, Khandwa in RCT No. 281/2021 whereby the application filed by the applicant for cancellation of warrant under Section 70(2) of Cr.P.C. has been dismissed.
It is submitted by the applicant that he is facing trial before JMFC, Harsood, District Khandwa under Section 420 of IPC in RCT No. 281/2021.
During trial, the applicant was released on bail.

However, due to spread of Covid-19 vires and throat infection, which was later developed into cancer, to the father of the applicant, he could not appear before the trial Court, hence warrant of arrest was issued against him on 7.3.2021, therefore, tt is submitted by the applicant that the afoesaid waarant of arrest may be cancelled.

sentences.text: I have heard the applicant.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and grounds mentioned in this petition, this petition is hereby disposed of with the direction to the applicant to surrender before the trial Court concerned within 7 days from today.
If applicant surrenders before the trial Court concerned within 7 days from today, the trial Court shall release the applicant on bail on the terms and conditions as may deem fit by the trial Court.
The trial Court shall forfeit a sum of Rs.3,000/- from the bail bonds earlier furnished by the applicant.
